trigger.description: `ee focus suggest --task-frame <id>` could not resolve the named task frame — the frame id is unknown, the `.ee/task_frames.json` store is unreadable, or `show_task_frame` returned an error. The pipeline honors the explicit scope by returning empty `recommendations[]` and emits this degraded entry so the caller can verify the frame id; the unscoped fallback behavior the earlier draft described was removed in fix 0261a4ab to mirror the `Ok(empty)` arm above (silently broadening would mask the configuration error behind a populated recommendation list).
